response.original_title: Black Eyed Peas - Live at Expo 2020 Dubai
response.overview: Black Eyed Peas perform live at Expo 2020 Dubai in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, on January 25, 2022. The group delivers an energetic performance at Al Wasl Plaza, featuring a mix of their biggest hits and songs from their more recent work in a large-scale concert production.
response.tagline: The Black Eyed Peas take the stage at Expo 2020 Dubai
